sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 26 (#25), Internal Quality Checks row 26 (#25), rows 25/30 context, Deterministic Checks C28
evidence: All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1), and every judge.toml wires the playwright-mcp server (judge.toml:8-12; functional also has the restart_mcp verifier at :14-18). Source and memory are ruled out explicitly: render says 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints says 'Use only rendered browser behavior and the live DOM' and to decide the surface 'from the listed DOM facts only, not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks' (:5); functional/polish say 'do not read implementation files to infer success' (functional:22, polish:19); visual says 'Do not read implementation files' (:20). First paint is ruled out: the scored prompts each have a live-browser global gate (functional/polish/visual:5); the render criterion requires a load plus a reload (render judge.toml cw_workspace_loads_and_reloads); visual requires a 1440x900 resize, a ten-line Run, a caret screenshot and a double-click selection before scoring (visual:13-14); functional/polish demand quoted observations from this session (functional:11,18; polish:15). Flagged hosted defect (public https address of the judge's choice): fixed. No https URL remains in app_context.md or any judge.toml (grep). app_context.md:27 now gives only http://localhost:3000/api/health and http://127.0.0.1:3000, and says 'No criterion needs any address outside this machine'. cw_preview_isolation (functional judge.toml:321-327) uses the notes' health address plus http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health, so the judge never browses off-machine. Checked for a new defect: the golden preview is a sandbox='allow-scripts' iframe at the other loopback name (runtime.ts run(), localhost<->127.0.0.1) whose written document carries a meta CSP with connect-src 'none' (runtime.ts:7). Both no-cors fetches therefore reject in the golden, and an app with a same-origin or allow-same-origin preview fails on the parent-read or storage probes. That is the browser behaviour the criterion measures, not a source read. Weak-app probe: a page that loads but has a dead Run or Save cannot pass by first paint, because the criteria need Run output, saved records read back after clearing storage, and a restart re-read. Conforming alternative: canvas or SVG editors are explicitly allowed (constraints criterion; app_context.md:31). Script use is limited to three named actions (app_context.md:29), and real page.mouse/page.keyboard input is allowed, so nothing pushes the judge toward source inspection. Not measured: no raw-evidence-index.json exists for this run and no full configured judge transcript for v16, so whether the judge actually drove the browser has not been observed in a run. Row 25 asks about prompt content, which the source settles, so this gap does not block the row.
